items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Uh, Paul Mouye and his brother Ernest.

ctx.x: And who did you take the Bunky?

Uh, Paul Mouye and his brother Ernest. Ernest, he's. Ernest, he's. Ernest, he's. He's past, he's past. He's past, you know. He's past, he's past. Kid Ernest. Kid Ernest. Kid Ernest. I take him out the Bunky with me. Oh, he's quick to look at my kid. Well, they didn't have no wives, you see, and they couldn't make the trip. The other boys married, they couldn't leave the family, see. The only way I did with me.

I didn't wait for Stale. The other business got low. It's kind of low, so he decided. Decided. Yeah, then he went to Texas and we'll be playing when we came back home. Yeah. Yeah, I played in Texas. I mean, he still wanted us to go out there. Yeah, I didn't want to play. There you go.
